evidence:
Verbatim concluding paragraphs from the actual structured Sonnet review:

Core privacy fix is architecturally sound: `hasAnalyticsConsent()` correctly requires CONSENT_KEY='true' AND VERSION_KEY='2' AND (source=null OR source='user'); `stopAnalytics()` immediately aborts all active AbortControllers and increments the generation counter before any storage write; `setAnalyticsConsent(allow)` sets `consentBlocked=true` up-front so the gate fails closed even if storage writes fail; Vercel `inject()` is removed from module-load in `src/main.ts` and correctly placed inside `initAnalytics()` behind `isAnalyticsAllowed()`. The reset notice correctly uses `role="status"` (non-blocking), does not call `.focus()`, and cannot grant consent. Release capability derivation correctly enforces version boundaries (147/148) and edition filtering via AST-parsed panel counts. `package.json` stays at 2.25.147 as intended for this source-only delivery.

Two nonblocking observations noted; no blocking findings.

Verbatim findings from that same actual review:

    "severity": "nonblocking",
    "path": "src/services/analytics.ts",
    "line": 348,
    "message": "`_setCaptureForTest()` resets `consentBlocked`, `pendingResetNotice`, `resetNoticeShown`, and increments `consentGeneration`, but does not reset `consentListenersAdded`. If a test in the same direct-import test file ever calls `initAnalytics()` (which calls `attachConsentListeners()`), subsequent tests in that file will not re-attach storage/mode-changed listeners after `_setCaptureForTest(null)`. Current test suites avoid this \u2014 consent tests never call `initAnalytics()` directly, and lifecycle tests use esbuild-bundled fresh module instances \u2014 so no test failures result. Consider resetting `consentListenersAdded = false` in `_setCaptureForTest` to protect future tests."
  },

    "message": "In `mountResetNotice()`, both `role=\"status\"` and `aria-live=\"polite\"` are set on the notice element. Per the ARIA spec, `role=\"status\"` already implies an `aria-live=\"polite\"` live region; the explicit attribute is redundant. This is harmless and causes no functional or test issue, but the redundant attribute could be removed for clarity."
  }
